now.summary: Independent consultant building working tools that apply large language models to the most paperwork-heavy steps of regulated and engineering processes, and researching automated trading systems. The work is published as open source where possible.
focus: LLM agents for document-heavy regulatory workflows. Open-source projects: SaMD Regulatory Playbook, SFDA and UAE EDE pre-check agents, UAE business setup advisor, MENA AI compliance advisor.

Automated BTC trading research based on image-style "fingerprint" encodings of market data. Development continues and recent experiments look promising (self-reported, not yet published). The methodology and code are planned as an open-source release. The published results document covers the earlier phase of this work.
Collecting and publishing the supporting documents (programmes, certificates) for the claims in this profile.
now.consulting: For consulting or more information, get in touch via LinkedIn.

SaMD-Regulatory-Playbook.why: Regulatory requirements keep changing, and the document work they generate takes a lot of time in engineering and production. The playbook and its agent toolkit explore how evolving regulations can be built into AI-assisted document workflows to speed those steps up.
SaMD-Regulatory-Playbook.also: It is also a way to gain hands-on experience with regulatory work from the product side.

SFDA-Regulatory-Compliance-Agent.why: Beyond advising on AI transformation, the aim is to build working tools that use LLMs where the paperwork load is heaviest and help people get through those processes faster.
SFDA-Regulatory-Compliance-Agent.status: Published on 2026-09-24 as a demonstration with synthetic data.

EDE-Regulatory-Compliance-Agent.why: Same aim as the SFDA agent, applied to UAE Emirates Drug Establishment submissions.
EDE-Regulatory-Compliance-Agent.status: Published on 2026-09-24 as a demonstration with synthetic data.

UAE-Business-Setup-Advisor.why: Business setup and renewal involve scattered, document-heavy steps. The project explores an advisor that only answers from verified sources.
UAE-Business-Setup-Advisor.status: Published on 2026-09-24 as a demonstration with sample data.

MENA-AI-Compliance-Advisor.why: Companies adopting AI in the region face a large amount of source material. The project explores source-grounded support that quotes the official text.

btc-ml-research-results.why: The goal is an automated trading bot built on image-style "fingerprint" encodings of market data.
btc-ml-research-results.status: In development. The published document covers the May-June 2026 phase; later experiments are still being validated.
btc-ml-research-results.next: Continue development and release the work as an open-source project.

Ali-Can-Efe-Expert-MCP.why: One place where accurate information about the author is available to anyone who asks, whether an employer, a client or a colleague.
Ali-Can-Efe-Expert-MCP.status: Published on 2026-09-29 and served from Cloudflare Workers.

log.title: SaMD Regulatory Playbook and this profile server published
log.entry: Published the SaMD Regulatory Playbook (guides, templates and an agent toolkit) and this MCP server, which is now served from Cloudflare Workers.

log.title: Four compliance and business-setup agents published
log.entry: Published open-source agents for SFDA and UAE EDE medical device submission pre-checks, a UAE business setup advisor and a MENA AI compliance advisor. All four are demonstrations or informational examples, not legal or regulatory advice.

log.title: BTC machine-learning research
log.entry: Worked through a long series of experiments on BTC/USDT (versions 8 to 87): image-style encodings, masked-autoencoder pretraining, gradient boosting and synthetic-data controls. Published the results and the validation lessons, including the failures. The code stays private for now.
